description: This PHP class EmployeeGender models an employee's gender as a stringable object. It implements a toString method that translates the gender constant into a human-readable string ('Male', 'Female', 'Other') based on the value passed during construction.

classes.name: EmployeeGender
classes.description: A class representing an employee's gender, providing a string representation based on gender constants.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the EmployeeGender object with a gender value, which can be null or an integer representing gender.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation ('Male', 'Female', 'Other') of the gender, or null if gender value is unrecognized or null.
